text: The voice recognition is honestly incredible, the best I've seen. Since they've got that nailed, I hope later editions include more UX/UI development. The manual keyboard is dreadful. It doesn't allow for slide typing, and it has no punctuation on the main keyboard, so I have to tap over to another keyboard view every time I want a comma. There are also no customization/long press options. In short, there's nothing better IMO for voice to text. On everything ancillary to that, it underwhelms.
